principle: Higher authority wins unless an explicit exception exists.

conflicts.description: Conflict between SOUL (L0) and Specification (L1) authorities
conflicts.resolution_rule: SOUL always wins. SPEC must be revised to align with SOUL.
examples: Specification introduces third font family (violates SOUL Two Voices principle)
Color palette includes neon/cyberpunk colors (violates SOUL Quiet Luxury)
Photography guidelines approve cyberpunk imagery (violates SOUL Human Experience)

conflicts.description: Conflict between Specification (L1) and Token/System Authority (L2)
conflicts.resolution_rule: SPEC wins. TOKEN implementation must be updated to match SPEC.
examples: Token class returns incorrect color value compared to specification
TypographyTokens scale doesn't match specification
GlowIconRegistry doesn't contain all specified icons

conflicts.description: Conflict between Token/System Authority (L2) and Component (L3)
conflicts.resolution_rule: TOKEN wins. COMPONENT must use tokens as defined.
examples: Component uses hardcoded color instead of Token.color
Component uses custom TextStyle instead of TypographyTokens
Component uses arbitrary spacing values instead of Spacing tokens

conflicts.resolution_rule: COMPONENT wins. SCREEN must use components as defined.
examples: Screen creates custom button variant instead of using official PrimaryButton
Screen creates custom card instead of using official ProductCard
Screen bypasses official navigation component

conflicts.description: Conflict between Screen (L4) and Legacy Systems
conflicts.resolution_rule: SCREEN (new) wins over LEGACY. LEGACY must be migrated or deprecated.
conflicts.escalation_path: L4 Governor reviews and enforces migration plan.
examples: New screen uses legacy theme instead of Token-based theming
Screen uses legacy icon set instead of GlowIcon
Screen uses legacy typography system instead of TypographyTokens

conflicts.resolution_rule: The more recently updated LEGACY system wins, but both must be migrated to canonical.
conflicts.escalation_path: L1/L2 Governor reviews and enforces migration.
examples: Two different legacy color systems both in use
Two different legacy typography systems both in use
Legacy component libraries conflict with each other

conflicts.description: Conflict between duplicate authorities covering same domain
conflicts.resolution_rule: Canonical (as defined in Single Source of Truth Map) wins. Duplicates must be deprecated or mapped.
conflicts.escalation_path: L1 Governor reviews and enforces deprecation/mapping.
examples: both Token and GlowStoreTokens used for color access
both TypographyTokens and AppTypography used for text styles
both GlowIconRegistry and direct Material icons used

conflicts.resolution_rule: SOUL wins. AI implementation must be revised to align with SOUL.
examples: AI introduces cyberpunk/neon/HUD aesthetics (violates SOUL Quiet Luxury)
AI decisions made without human confirmation for critical actions
AI uses prohibited color schemes or imagery

conflicts.resolution_rule: Security wins. Implementation must meet security rules.
examples: Implementation stores auth tokens in SharedPreferences
Implementation bypasses encryption for personal data
Implementation lacks required access controls

conflicts.resolution_rule: Accessibility wins. Implementation must meet accessibility rules.
examples: Implementation lacks proper focus styles
Implementation has insufficient color contrast
Implementation doesn't respect text scaling

conflicts.resolution_rule: Performance wins. Implementation must meet performance budgets.
examples: Implementation causes excessive frame drops
Implementation has large bundle size
Implementation has slow startup time

conflicts.resolution_rule: Quality wins. Implementation must meet quality gates.
examples: Implementation skips required tests
Implementation has known bugs not addressed
Implementation violates coding standards
